description:
Create and schedule a social media post across one or more platforms via Schedulala.

Supported platforms: twitter, instagram, linkedin, facebook, youtube, bluesky, tiktok, telegram, threads, pinterest, mastodon, google-business.

Scheduling options (pick exactly one): scheduledFor (ISO 8601, 5 min to 90 days out), publishNow: true (publish immediately), queue: true (auto-scheduling queue), or status: "draft" (save without scheduling).

Character limits: twitter=280, bluesky=300, threads=500, mastodon=500, google-business=1500, instagram=2200, tiktok=2200, linkedin=3000, telegram=4096, facebook=63206. (YouTube uses a 100-char title + 5000-char description; Pinterest uses a 100-char title + 500-char description — supply these via platformSettings.)

google-business supports postType STANDARD/EVENT/OFFER with CTA buttons via platformSettings; exactly one image, no video. The CTA is two FLAT string fields, not a nested object: platformSettings["google-business"] = { "callToAction": "LEARN_MORE", "actionUrl": "https://..." }. Valid callToAction values: BOOK, ORDER, SHOP, LEARN_MORE, SIGN_UP, GET_OFFER, CALL. actionUrl is required for every type except CALL.

Media: provide mediaItems with public URLs. Multiple items = carousel (instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, pinterest; mastodon up to 4 images). Instagram requires at least one media item; YouTube requires a video. If the user's photos/videos are on their device or attached in the chat, call attach_media first (where available - it opens an in-chat upload widget, the "drop zone", at full quality) and use the urls it reports; never read and base64-encode attached files yourself. If the user supplies a source media URL to attach (or the link may expire), call upload_media first and use the url it returns here.

Per-platform content: pass platforms as objects with a content field to override text per platform, or use platformSettings.

First Comment (auto-plug): pass firstComment (plain string) or firstComments ([{target, text}]) to auto-post a comment under the post ~15 seconds after it publishes - the standard "link in the first comment" workflow. Supported on 8 platforms: linkedin, facebook, instagram, youtube, twitter, threads, bluesky, mastodon. NOT supported on tiktok, pinterest, telegram, google-business (no comment API): selecting ONLY unsupported platforms with a first comment is a validation error; mixed selections publish the comment where supported and warn about the rest. Comments are text and links only, no media. Comment limits: instagram=1000 UTF-8 bytes, linkedin=1500, twitter=280, bluesky=300, threads=500, youtube=10000 characters; facebook and mastodon have no fixed limit. target 0 = the main post; targets above 0 address thread entries and only work with create_thread (twitter/threads/bluesky). A failed comment never fails the post - check get_post's platforms[].firstComments for per-account delivery status (posted with the comment url, failed, or skipped).

TikTok: platformSettings.tiktok.privacy (e.g. 'PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE', 'SELF_ONLY') AND platformSettings.tiktok.postMode are both required. postMode is 'direct' (publish straight to the profile) or 'inbox' (send to the user's TikTok app inbox to finish manually) - there is no default, and you must ASK the user which they want if they haven't said.

brandId.description: Workspace / brand id to post under (from an account's brandId).

content.description: Main post text. Can be omitted if media-only or fully overridden per-platform.

externalId.description: Your own id to correlate this post with your system.

firstComment.description: Auto-post this text as the first comment right after the post publishes (shorthand for firstComments: [{target: 0, text}]). See the First Comment section of the description for supported platforms and limits.

firstComments.description: Auto-posted first comments as [{target, text}]. target 0 = main post; higher targets only apply to threads created via create_thread.

target.description: 0 = the main post (default); i = thread entry i+1 (create_thread on twitter/threads/bluesky only).

text.description: Comment text - links allowed, no media.

mediaItems.description: Media to attach via public URLs. Multiple items = carousel (instagram, facebook, threads, tiktok, pinterest; mastodon up to 4 images).

caption.description: Optional caption/alt text for this item.

type.description: Media type. 'pdf' = a LinkedIn document post (linkedin only).

platformSettings.description: Per-platform overrides keyed by platform name (e.g. { youtube: { title, description } }).

platforms.description: Target platforms. Strings (e.g. 'twitter') work only when ONE account is connected on that platform; with multiple accounts use the object form with accountId (otherwise the API 400s listing the choices). Objects can also set per-platform content.

accountId.description: Specific connected account id (from list_accounts). REQUIRED when more than one account is connected on the platform (the API returns a 400 listing the choices rather than silently picking one); may be omitted only when exactly one account is connected.

content.description: Override text for this platform only.

queue.description: Use the auto-scheduling queue to pick the next open slot.

scheduledFor.description: ISO 8601 datetime to schedule the post. Must be 5 minutes to 90 days in the future.

name: create_post
